eye level: camera at eye level, neutral documentary perspective, natural proportions
slightly high angle: slightly high camera angle looking gently down, softens features, slight vulnerability
slightly low angle: slightly low camera angle looking up, subtle confidence and presence
from below: camera placed low looking upward, dramatic stature, elongated legs and strong jaw emphasis
low-angle hero shot: classic low-angle hero shot, powerful stance, sky or ceiling behind subject
3/4 angle: three-quarter view of the face and body, dimensional cheek and shoulder line
rear 3/4 angle: rear three-quarter view, subject looking back over the shoulder, editorial fashion energy
profile angle: true side profile, clean silhouette of nose and jaw, graphic outline
dutch angle: dutch tilt canted horizon, uneasy or dynamic tension in the frame
overhead selfie angle: high overhead phone-like angle, face tilted up toward lens, social-media selfie grammar
mirror selfie angle: mirror selfie composition, phone partially visible, subject reflected in glass
phone camera angle: handheld phone camera feel, slight wide-angle distortion, casual snapshot realism
